subject: First order + new account - Draaischijf Koffie (Amsterdam-Noord)
body:
Hello Harbor Lane,

We're opening Draaischijf Koffie on 24 October in Amsterdam-Noord, a small specialty café with about 30 seats. Sophie at Maple & Rye recommended you. We'd like to open an account and place a first order:

- House Espresso Blend 1kg: 6 bags
- Haverland Barista Oat: 4 cases
- Whole milk 1L: 3 cases
- 8oz double wall cups: 1 box
- 8oz lids: 1 box
- Vanilla syrup: 2 bottles

Ideally delivered on Thursday 22 October so we can do a test week on the machine.

Invoice details:
Draaischijf Koffie V.O.F.
Gedempt Hamerkanaal 140, 1021 KP Amsterdam
KvK 91827364
IBAN NL91 ABNA 0417 1643 00 (direct debit is fine)

Let me know if you need anything else from us.

Best,
Sanne Hoekstra
Draaischijf Koffie
06 4127 9930
